name: AReT (Anatomy-Regularized TensoRF)
definition: An anatomy-regularized tensorial NeRF framework for 3D lung nodule volumetry from three orthogonal digitally reconstructed radiographs (DRRs: coronal, sagittal, axial).
summary: AReT reconstructs 3D lung nodules from three orthogonal DRRs using TensoRF with corrected density initialization and anatomy-aware regularization to overcome sparse-view limitations.
